headline: US Vice President JD Vance postpones trip to Switzerland for Iran talks
summary: The visit was intended to discuss next steps for a US-Iran agreement to end the war in the Middle East, but the White House cited unpredictable logistics.
details: US Vice President JD Vance has postponed his trip to Switzerland for talks on the US-Iran agreement to end the Middle East war. The White House stated that the logistics of these negotiations have never been simple or predictable.
The move comes after a deal was signed on Wednesday by Donald Trump and Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian, initiating a 60-day period for talks on wider issues, including Iran's nuclear programme.
Iran's supreme leader Ayatollah Mojtaba Khamenei has approved the deal despite having reservations. He stated that he gave permission due to the commitment to protect the Iranian nation's rights.

As part of the agreement, the US has already lifted its naval blockade of Iranian ports, though American warships remain in the general area. Iran has also opened the Strait of Hormuz for shipping with no fees for 60 days.

The deal aims to end a five-week all-out war that resulted in the 13 US service members killed. However, French President Emmanuel Macron and some Iranian citizens express doubt about the lasting nature of the peace.

Under the terms, Washington will waive oil sanctions on Iran's economy. Once a final agreement on the nuclear programme is reached, the US will facilitate a $300 billion reconstruction fund supported by regional nations.
caption:
A critical diplomatic push to end the Middle East war hits a snag as US Vice President JD Vance cancels his Swiss trip.

US Vice President JD Vance has postponed his trip to Switzerland for talks on the US-Iran agreement to end the Middle East war. The White House stated that the logistics of these negotiations have never been simple or predictable.

The move comes after a deal was signed on Wednesday by Donald Trump and Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian, initiating a 60-day period for talks on wider issues, including Iran's nuclear programme.

Iran's supreme leader Ayatollah Mojtaba Khamenei has approved the deal despite having reservations. He stated that he gave permission due to the commitment to protect the Iranian nation's rights.

As part of the agreement, the US has already lifted its naval blockade of Iranian ports, though American warships remain in the general area. Iran has also opened the Strait of Hormuz for shipping with no fees for 60 days.

The deal aims to end a five-week all-out war that resulted in the 13 US service members killed. However, French President Emmanuel Macron and some Iranian citizens express doubt about the lasting nature of the peace.

Under the terms, Washington will waive oil sanctions on Iran's economy. Once a final agreement on the nuclear programme is reached, the US will facilitate a $300 billion reconstruction fund supported by regional nations.

headline_marked: 33 tons of [[government rice seized in Sherpur]]
headline: 33 tons of government rice seized in Sherpur
summary: A mobile court raid on a rice processing warehouse in Chapatali area seized 33 tons of food-friendly program rice worth 16 lakh BDT.
details: A mobile court seized 33 tons of government rice intended for the food-friendly program in Sherpur.
The operation took place at midnight on Thursday, June 18, at the Jabin Rice Processing warehouse in the Chapatali area of the city.
According to police, the raid was conducted based on secret information that government rice was being transferred from old sacks to new ones at the warehouse.
The seized rice is estimated to be worth approximately 16 lakh BDT.
The warehouse owner, Borhan Uddin, was arrested during the operation.
Police are currently investigating whether anyone else was involved in the illegal hoarding of the government rice.
caption:
33 tons of government rice worth 16 lakh BDT seized in a midnight raid in Sherpur!

A mobile court seized 33 tons of government rice intended for the food-friendly program in Sherpur.

The operation took place at midnight on Thursday, June 18, at the Jabin Rice Processing warehouse in the Chapatali area of the city.

According to police, the raid was conducted based on secret information that government rice was being transferred from old sacks to new ones at the warehouse.

The seized rice is estimated to be worth approximately 16 lakh BDT.

The warehouse owner, Borhan Uddin, was arrested during the operation.

Police are currently investigating whether anyone else was involved in the illegal hoarding of the government rice.
